description: Free to call. Returns the best route and an unsigned transaction, and for Solana swaps a rug-pull risk check of the output token (mint/freeze authority, token-2022 traps, holder concentration) so agents do not buy honeypots. Same-chain Solana swaps route through Jupiter with a referral fee account. Cross-chain and EVM swaps route through LI.FI with an integrator fee. The response contains a serialized unsigned transaction to be signed and broadcast by the caller. A 30 bps platform fee is embedded in the route.

amount.description: Input amount in base units (lamports, wei, 1e-6 USDC)

destinationAddress.description: Receiver on toChain; defaults to userAddress

inputToken.description: Token address/mint, or symbol (SOL, USDC, USDT, ETH)

userAddress.description: Wallet that signs the transaction on fromChain

name: swap_quote_and_build
